answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using subterranean radio attestation. Each agent emits radio pulses through bedrock like shale using a grounded copper stake, verifying propagation delays with neighboring peers. This forces an adversary to occupy scarce physical land and deploy dedicated RF hardware per identity. Challenges seeded by complex text, like an input sonnet, prevent replay attacks. However, fluctuating soil moisture alters ground conductivity, causing false rejections.
